prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: the specific TENTH ARHAT PANTHAKA (半托迦) in the painted clay arhat series at ZIJIN'AN, DONGSHAN, SUZHOU 苏州东山紫金庵第十尊者半托迦（上身局部）. Image2 is a two-panel REAL PHOTOGRAPH COLLAGE of the SAME arhat seen from two close angles. Make ONE single drawing, NOT a collage and NOT two figures. Use the LEFT photo's more frontal angle for overall pose and the RIGHT photo for hand/collar detail. This is an intentionally selected UPPER-BODY DETAIL, from the complete bald head through the two forearms and hands resting across the wooden armrest; do not invent unseen legs, feet, whole seat or pedestal. Preserve the distinctive gently TILTED BALD head, elongated narrow face, drooping thin eyes, long nose, gently parted closed lips, long hanging ears, slender neck and exposed upper chest with the straight garment edge. The loose outer robe falls over both shoulders with green-trimmed broad lapels in the reference. In black line art preserve lapel edges only, not pigment. Preserve the casual closely crossed forearms, with one hand laid over the other at the center and the long relaxed FINGERS DANGLING down over the horizontal dark red armrest. Exactly TWO HANDS, each with5fingers, the actual overlapping gesture and armrest orientation from the left reference panel. Keep the gentle shoulder slope and slightly side-turning head rather than straightening it into a symmetric Buddha. Do not copy the style master's Vairocana face, hair curls, broken arms or robe. Show the head, shoulders, hands, upper robe and the short real armrest completely; let a few robe contours taper into white immediately below the hands, so this is clearly a bust detail with no invented lower body. Include only3to5short flowing contours suggesting the actual sculpted clouds behind the shoulders; omit other figures and leave the rest pure white. No halo. The robe has2or3chosen band edges but NO repeated embroidery patterns, dragons, floral filler or dense textile texture. Discard original collage divider, photographic borders and all Chinese watermarks: NO TEXT. Very thin delicate black contour lines on purewhite with absolutely no colored or gray fill, no black sleeves, no shadow, no hatching. Portrait1024x1536. Single upper-body detail centered at approximately75%height, generous blank margins, quiet controlled line density like image1.

site_recommendation.yearNote: 1200仅为宋代罗汉艺术传统的时间轴约略定位，非确切塑造年；文保名录时代为宋—明，雷潮夫妇为相传作者。
site_recommendation.latlon_note: 紫金庵公开坐标31°03′41″N120°22′51″E，非单尊像室内位置。
site_recommendation.lede: 深藏东山坞中的十六尊罗汉，各有神情与姿态。倾首、垂目与轻轻交叠的手指，让安静的泥塑带着日常人物的生气。

facts.label: 宋明塑像
facts.text: 文保名录将紫金庵罗汉塑像列为宋至明；相传出自南宋雷潮夫妇之手，作者并无定论。

facts.label: 十六罗汉
facts.text: 罗汉列于殿内两侧，衣纹、坐姿和神情各异，本图选取半托迦尊者的上身局部。

facts.label: 历代修护
facts.text: 塑像历经修护，今日所见包含不同时期的彩绘与修补；现存殿宇年代另计。
